title: The whole team is locked out
ticket: Our entire team of 45 people cannot access the reporting dashboard. Every login succeeds but reports return a 503 error. This started two hours ago and we cannot deliver our client reports. There is no workaround. Please escalate to an engineer immediately.

title: Charged twice for one subscription
ticket: I see two identical subscription charges of $29 on my statement for the same order. I only subscribed once. Please investigate the duplicate payment and arrange a refund for the extra charge. My subscription otherwise works normally.

title: Where can I change my theme?
ticket: Hello! I am exploring the product and would like to know whether dark mode is available. Everything is working fine. This is a general product question, not a bug report. No rush.

title: Login, billing, and an invoice
ticket: I need help with three separate things: I forgot my password and cannot log in; there is a duplicate charge on my card; and I need a copy of last month's invoice emailed to me. Can you help with all three?

title: Recurring outages before renewal
ticket: Your app has gone down every week this month. We are back online now, but this has cost our team hours of work. Our renewal is next Monday. Unless an account manager addresses this today, we will cancel our subscription.

title: A two-factor prompt I did not request
ticket: I keep receiving two-factor authentication prompts even though I am not trying to log in. I am worried someone is trying to access my account. Please have a security specialist investigate. Sending a generic password-reset article will not resolve this concern.

title: The issue needs another look
ticket: It happened again. This still is not right. Please check it.

title: CSV import freezes on Android
ticket: On Android 13, app version 4.2 freezes whenever I import a 40 MB CSV. Steps: open Imports, select the CSV, tap Import. Expected: rows appear. Actual: spinner never stops. Small files work, and I can use the desktop app as a workaround.
